title: Southern Lifts - Sliding Elevator Doors as Menu & 3D Lift Hero

affordance_translation.physical_behavior: Elevator doors part in the middle to admit you; the cabin itself travels between floors; a door swings on hinges with an arc you can trace.
affordance_translation.digital_mechanic: For a lift company whose product IS the metaphor: the menu icon opens a menu animated as elevator doors sliding apart; a scroll-driven 3D lift hero carries the user through the product; an interactive door-swing diagram demonstrates installation geometry on hover. The brand's physical product is the navigation system.

design_tokens.borders: Metal panel seams and brushed-steel door parting lines; minimal chrome elsewhere
design_tokens.elevation: 3D cabin lighting and reflections; UI panels flat
design_tokens.typography: Engineered grotesque; spec-sheet style labels for the door diagram

interactive_mechanics: Menu opens as sliding elevator doors (icon = door state)
Scroll-driven 3D lift ride as hero narrative
Hover-driven interactive door swing diagram for install geometry
usability_notes: The rare case where a physical metaphor is literally the product - the door-menu is brand logic, not decoration. Keep the doors animation under ~600ms and always reveal a static menu fallback for AT users; 3D hero needs mobile LOD. Source: Awwwards nominee element listing (itsy-bytesy).
